notes: restore-required because of oca-addons/contract 18.0.2.0.0. That migration is an OCA major-version restructure: it moves a dozen contract.line fields out to contract_line_successor and contract_termination, deletes the contract_template_line_form_view, and removes ir_model rows for four abstract models. Once it has run, the previous image is looking for fields and a view that are no longer where it expects them, so rolling the image back does not roll the database back. Recovery from a failed upgrade is restore-from-backup, not image revert. Every other migration in this release is additive -- the Majal ones write data and install record rules, the remaining OCA ones add columns -- and on their own would have been forward-compatible. Note the trigger: this only fires when upgrading a database whose contract module predates 18.0.2.0.0. A first install on an empty database registers 18.0.2.0.0 directly and runs no migration at all, so the first go-live deployment is not exposed to it.
